blocks.text: Lea Salonga is set to take on the role of the fierce matriarch in the upcoming Filipino-language stage production of “Ang Tahanan ni Bernarda Alba.” Salonga will portray the titular Bernarda Alba in Theatre Group Asia’s (TGA) Philippine staging of Federico García Lorca’s “The House of Bernarda Alba,” adapted by director-playwright Chay Yew and translated into Filipino by Guelan Valera Luarca. The production is scheduled to run in February 2027. It will be TGA’s first production performed entirely in Filipino.
